name: Zeus Sport
note: Italian technical-apparel maker (kit supplier of Frosinone Calcio; its company page says the brand began in 1999 in Torre Annunziata, Naples, and lists Frosinone Calcio among the teams it dresses, zeusport.it/en/azienda.html). Company-register aggregators list Zeus Sport S.r.l. (VAT 05520931212, Torre Annunziata, wholesale of sporting articles; 2023 revenue reported as EUR 21.1m on FatturatoAzienda.it), but the shareholder data is behind a paywall, so no owner could be sourced; kept unrated.
